description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R percentage for different LLaMA models with varying SFT configurations. The horizontal axis represents the LLaMA models, labeled as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10. Each model is associated with a group of four bars, representing different SFT configurations: no SFT (blue), + SFT on D0 (yellow), + SFT on D0, D1 (purple), and + SFT on D0, D1, D2 (red). The bars within each group are positioned side by side. For LLaMA-2-7B, the bars have approximate values of 68, 68, 80, and 81; for LLaMA-2-13B, the values are around 70, 70, 79, and 80; and for LLaMA-2-70B, the values are approximately 74, 75, 83, and 84. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
